This role exists to help Core States be that partner by building the people, systems, standards, and leadership depth required to deliver consistently at scale. This is a high-impact operational leadership opportunity for someone who knows how to strengthen client programs, improve performance, develop leaders, grow market share, and create a delivery platform that becomes a competitive advantage. Core States offers the client base, geographic reach, multi-disciplinary platform, and entrepreneurial environment for the right leader to make a meaningful impact on the business. Summary Of The Role The Senior Director of Civil Engineering - Multi-Site, is responsible to lead and own the performance, growth, and delivery consistency of Core States Group's national multi-site Civil Engineering teams. This role requires someone who can operate at both a strategic and execution-focused level, align people, process, client expectations, financial performance, and delivery standards, and create delivery models that support continued growth. Key Responsibilities Lead the performance, growth, and delivery consistency of national Multi-Site Civil Engineering teams, with accountability for client service, team performance, overall financial performance, quality, and sustainable growth. Strengthen delivery systems, team structures, workflows, quality expectations, communication standards, and performance expectations across national program teams. Build a national delivery platform that strengthens client confidence, improves execution, supports growth, and becomes a competitive advantage for Core States Group. Build, mentor, and develop high-performing Multi-Site Civil Engineering teams with the leadership depth and technical capability required to support national client programs. Create a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, service, and continuous improvement. Strengthen national client relationships by understanding client needs, improving responsiveness, and helping teams deliver with consistency and trust. Partner with client leaders, project teams, market leaders, and technical teams to support program delivery, strategic pursuits, and expanded client opportunities. Drive consistent execution across client programs, including scope management, schedule performance, budget accountability, project setup, change management, invoicing discipline, and closeout. Use performance data, client feedback, and business insight to identify trends, address gaps, improve resource planning, and strengthen delivery outcomes. More consistent delivery across national client programs. Stronger client relationships, improved responsiveness, expanded repeat business, and greater market share. Improved overall financial performance, resource planning, and workload management. Greater consistency in quality, communication, schedule performance, and execution. Stronger leadership depth and team accountability across national program teams. A stronger culture of excellence, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Qualifications We are looking for a senior civil engineering leader with strong business judgement, operational leadership capability, technical credibility, and the ability to lead complex teams serving national and programmatic clients. The right leader must understand how to scale delivery, improve performance, and grow client relationships as a buisness. Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related discipline required. Professional Engineering license strongly preferred. MBA, advanced business degree, or demonstrated business leadership experience strongly preferred. Significant civil engineering leadership experience, including responsibility for client relationships, team leadership, program delivery, overall financial performance, and operational execution. Demonstrated success leading national client programs, scaling delivery teams, improving operational performance, or managing complex client portfolios. Strong business and financial acumen, including the ability to evaluate client growth opportunities, financial performance, staffing, resource planning, workload management, and operational priorities. Strong understanding of civil engineering delivery for multi-site, national, or programmatic clients, including scope, schedule, budget, permitting, quality, and client communication. Experience in civil site development, multi-site engineering, land development, infrastructure, national accounts, or related growth markets. Ability to lead through influence, build trust, align teams, mentor leaders, and communicate effectively with clients, teams, and company leadership. Demonstrated ability and willingness to identify practical uses for company-approved AI tools to improve team processes, support better decisions, and increase efficiency. Demonstrated ability to review AI-generated content for accuracy, protect confidential information, and remain responsible for the final work product. Leadership Qualifications The Senior Director of Civil Engineering - Multi-Site must lead with ownership, sound judgement, accountability, humility, a strong sense of stewardship, and a servant leadership mindset. This person must be highly motivated, business-minded, and capable of making thoughtful decisions in a complex, fast moving environment. They must be able to build trust with senior leaders, client leaders, technical experts, and delivery teams while raising the standard for how national program teams operate and serve clients. This role requires someone who can build on what is already working, strengthen operational performance, develop people, grow client relationships, and help Core States Group set the standard for national program delivery in the markets we serve. Work Location This can be a an on-site, hybrid or remote role across the United States with travel as required. With 26 offices across the United States and Canada, the firm delivers speed to market, cost certainty, and compelling design for national multisite programs and projects. Established in 1999, Core States Group drives innovation and improves everyday life for countless people across several markets, including Convenience, Distributed Generation, Financial, Grocery, Housing, Industrial, Restaurants, Retail, Semiconductor, Zero-Emission Vehicle (ZEV) Infrastructure, and more. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. This position will remain open until it is filled.

review_candidates.title: Postdoctoral Research Associate - Neural Circuits and Movement - Bikoff lab
review_candidates.description: Location Memphis, TN Category Postdoc Department Developmental Neurobiology Shift Weekday Day Position Type Full Time Scheduled Weekly Hours 40 Req # JR7470 Job Description A postdoctoral research associate position is available with Dr. Bikoff. The Bikoff lab (https://www.stjude.org/research/labs/bikoff-lab.html) in the Department of Developmental Neurobiology at St. Jude Children's Research Hospital is seeking a Postdoctoral Research Associate interested in studying motor circuitry in mice. Projects will focus on the synaptic and circuit organization of neurons in the spinal cord, and how these circuits ultimately shape motor output. Our laboratory aims to understand the organization and function of neural circuits that control movement, with a particular focus on circuits in the spinal cord that directly control motor output. Projects in the lab can be broadly organized into three thematic areas: dissecting the diversity of cell types in the nervous system, understanding the circuit architecture through which neurons receive and convey information, and defining the functional role of these circuits in motor control. This position will specifically focus on investigating the synaptic and circuit organization of genetically defined populations of spinal interneurons that are critically important for movement. The project will employ a range of approaches including mouse genetics, viral tracing strategies, single-cell and spatial transcriptomics, and imaging methodologies. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds who would thrive in a highly collaborative, fun, and supportive environment that also provides the freedom to independently develop a research project and take it in new directions. The Bikoff lab is strongly committed to providing individual mentoring and training, as well as ongoing support at all stages of career development. Required Qualifications A PhD or MD/PhD in neuroscience or a related discipline Strong experimental training and the ability to independently design and execute experiments and interpret data Ability to work in a multidisciplinary, highly collaborative environment Excellent oral and written communication skills Strong record of peer-reviewed publications Preferred Experience Prior experience in studying neural circuits, including familiarity with mouse genetics and viral tools Familiarity with programming languages (e.g. R, Python) and an ability to work with large datasets Familiarity with single-cell genomic and/or spatial transcriptomic approaches for molecular profiling St. Jude Children's Research Hospital is a world-class research institution dedicated to pediatric cancer and other catastrophic diseases of childhood. The first and only National Cancer Institute (NCI)-designated Comprehensive Cancer Center devoted solely to children. Our 300 faculty work across the spectrum of basic, translational, clinical, and population science in a highly collaborative multidisciplinary environment that includes a Nobel laureate and members of the National Academy of Science and the National Academy of Medicine. St. Jude is ranked on Fortune Magazine's "Best Workplaces in Health Care & Biopharma" and Glassdoor's "Best Places to Work," and is located in the heart of Memphis, Tennessee, a vibrant and friendly city at the historic American crossroads of music, trade, food and culture. We Are In Pursuit Of The Brightest Minds In Biomedical Sciences, Individuals Poised To Contribute To Our Research Progress. Other Than Access To Top-quality Scientists And Mentors, As a Postdoctoral Trainee At St. Jude, You Will Have A Blend of Academic Freedom and Industrial Efficiency: Access to shared resources and facilities led by expert scientists, coupled with cutting-edge technology, accelerates research productivity. Customized Professional and Career Growth: Experience specifically designed programs to enhance professional growth and career readiness empowering postdocs for success beyond their training. This includes access to grant writing workshops, individual development plans, teaching and mentoring opportunities, non-research career advancement programs, professional development allowance, and so much more. Competitive Compensation: Embark on your journey with a competitive salary starting at $72,500 a year, comprehensive benefits and generous relocation assistance, reflecting our commitment to recognize and invest in talent. A Sense of Community: St. Jude fosters a vibrant postdoc community that supports a well-balanced life. A dynamic environment promotes connections and camaraderie among postdocs from all backgrounds. St. Jude is an Equal Opportunity Employer No Search Firms St. Jude Children's Research Hospital does not accept unsolicited assistance from search firms for employment opportunities. Please do not call or email. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee or other representative at St. Jude via email, the internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place and approved by HR will result in no fee being paid in the event the candidate is hired by St. Jude.

The successful candidate will analyze business data, identify trends, prepare reports, and work with cross-functional teams to support effective planning and resource allocation. This is an excellent opportunity for an analytical professional who enjoys working with data, solving problems, and contributing to business growth and operational efficiency. Assist with forecasting, budgeting, and resource planning processes. Prepare regular reports, dashboards, and presentations for management. Maintain accurate planning models, databases, and reporting tools. Collaborate with Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Sales, and other departments. Strong attention to detail and organizational skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. Good written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team environment. Must be authorized to work in the United States. Preferred Qualifications Experience with forecasting, budgeting, or business planning. Knowledge of ERP, CRM, or business intelligence systems. Experience with Power BI, Tableau, SQL, or similar analytical tools. Understanding of financial and operational performance metrics. Previous experience working with cross-functional teams.
